The residue of $67$ modulo $6$ is the integer $0\le r<6$ such that

$$
67≡r\,(\text{mod}\,6).
$$

**Method 1**

To find the residue $r,$ we need to write $67$ as an integer multiple of $6,$ plus the residue $r.$

We note that $67≡1\,(\text{mod}\,6)$ because

$$
67=11\cdot 6+1.
$$

Therefore, the residue of $67$ modulo $6$ is $1.$

**Method 2**

We can use the subtraction property:

$$
\begin{aligned}67 & ≡67-0 &  & (\text{mod}\,6) \\  & ≡67-11\cdot 6 &  & (\text{mod}\,6) \\  & ≡67-66 &  & (\text{mod}\,6) \\  & ≡1 &  & (\text{mod}\,6)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the residue of $67$ modulo $6$ is $1.$
